title: Glimpsed classified UAP photos via colleagues

tellings.quote: so I began to see all sorts of stuff I told you about earlier photos and other things that said UAP are here

plain: A former CIA contractor named Bob McGwier says that through colleagues in secret government work he got to see classified photos and other material showing that UAP, the government's term for unidentified aerial phenomena, are real. He tells it as something he saw himself: "photos and other things that said UAP are here."
